item.title: Pantograph 1.1.3
item.description:
New

  • Automatic updates. Pantograph now checks for new versions about once a day and offers to install them, so you never need to come back here to update. Use Pantograph › Check for Updates… any time, and Settings › Updates to turn checking off or let updates install in the background.

Install: download Pantograph-1.1.3.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications, replacing the old copy. This is the last update you'll need to install by hand. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
